_doc: Ledger 0054 Phase 2 (Mission Gorge Speedway), step 2: the HELD race declaration of the north loop, on Lake Murray v4's committed intermediates (ledger 0065: v4 is the line). NOT in track.config.json and NOT enabled: plan_north.py beside this file merges it into a SCRATCH copy of the config and runs the race tools' plan modes (race_lap.stitch, layout_dummies, barrier_bands with the planned no_route). Everything here is keyed on the LAP's own vertices (data/lap.north.json, 2,936 unique vertices, 8,732.7 m with the declared J2-J4 curves): no mainline vertex number, no race.chicanes (College's crossover chicane is the mainline's, ledger 0055). Corridor limits are the existing Speedway's, unchanged (copied from race.corridor by plan_north.py except whole / boxes / closure_runs / pin_rate, which are the lap's own); clear_width_source none (the lap has no Alvarado to re-measure on). Activating it means copying lap + layouts into track.config.json AFTER the PC's authoring and built gates (ledger 0054 'Phase 2 - step 1..4').
built_on: Lake Murray v4 0.20.0 intermediates (claude/lm-v4-line): data/centerline.local.json, connectors.local.json, mouths.json, median_bands.json, pads.plan.json

north._roads_doc: street per vertex (barrier_bands._streets): v0 then each detected corner apex in order (J2 v320, J3 v707, J4 v1458, J5 v2130, J1 v2932), six spans: Waring from v0, Princess View, Mission Gorge, Jackson, Navajo, and the J1 turn from v2932 back to v0 (named apart: object names are per street)
north._joins_doc: J2, J3, J4: cubic curves off the roads' own approach tangents (832facf), a reference line through each pad, never an AI spline and never road geometry. J5 (11.6 m) and J1 (14.6 m) stay straight joins: both lie inside the mainline's own junction box (Navajo/Jackson, College/Navajo), whose pavement is built
north._junction_pads_doc: the three pads the lap drives through; their six stub arms (Mound Ave, Waring SW = the future Zion link, Mission Gorge W = the future Zion link, the quarry drive, Mission Gorge E, the MTRP entrance) become pad_arm mouths probed 10 m into the stub, before the Free Roam end barrier

corridor._whole_doc: Navajo westbound, mainline v2022..v1832 (undivided, 17.0 m): the whole street for the grid and the start / finish, 190 m

corridor._boxes_doc: PC-2 .. PT+2 of the five corners barrier_bands detects on the lap (place_signs' detector, min turn 45 deg), the mainline's rule; exactly five, one per junction
corridor._pin_rate_doc: none declared. Tried 695: 5.0 / 1470: 4.5 (2026-11-03): the solver still misses the declared rate by the same share. The cause (2026-11-04) was the smoothing, not the rate: see smooth_window

noses.why: Waring's raised median starts 30 m after the J1 box (v11, 1.5 m wide); a closure pinned on the far curb strip at v2 could only reach its race face at 1:1.8. The closure ends at the nose (pin v10) and a K-rail crosses the far carriageway there: your own side of the road (Kevin's call, ledger 0054)

Waring's median ends 24 m before the J2 box (v306, 3.0 m wide at its tail); from the far strip at v314 the closure crossed to it at 1:1.9. It ends at the tail (pin v307) with a K-rail across the far carriageway

Mission Gorge's splitter island starts 15 m after the J3 box (v718); from the far strip at v713 the closure crossed 16.6 m at 1:0.92, R 12 m. It ends at the nose (pin v717) with a K-rail across the far carriageway

corridor._noses_doc: tools/barrier_bands.py race.corridor.noses (ledger 0054 Phase 2): each closure-run end (a box edge) that ends at a median nose instead of the far curb strip; the pin is the vertex beside the nose, on the island's race face, and the K-rail runs from the closure's race face to the far curb strip, in that layout's closure kn5
corridor._smooth_window_doc: the closure's smoothing Gaussian over +-3 sigma of STATION with trapezoid weights (tools/race_corridor.py). The lap mixes 2 m curved joins with 3 m streets; the default +-4-vertex window is lopsided where they meet and pulled the closure off its own pin-zone envelope at v683-685 (1:5.49 of 1:6) and v1477-1479 (1:4.62 of 1:5.01). Not a threshold: the rates and limits are unchanged

trims.why: Held until the PC authors the J5 connection (Phase 2 step 1): the lap's J5 corner is an 11.6 m straight join inside the mainline's Navajo/Jackson box, R 9.1 m; its inside kerb folds on itself (race_furniture: no trim resolves it) and the mainline drops its own inside kerb here for the ribbon fold (race.kerbs.trims apex 2319). Re-declared once the corner surface is authored and measured on the built road

Held until the PC authors the J1 connection (Phase 2 step 1, coordinated with ledger 0055): the lap's J1 corner is a 14.6 m straight join inside the mainline's College/Navajo box, R 8.3 m, the same fold class; the mainline drops its own inside kerb here (apex 1514). Re-declared once the corner surface is authored and measured
